frozen_architecture.canonical_direction: Exact v0.1 absolute Market Structure; SUPPORTIVE >=62, PRESSURED <=38, otherwise MIXED.
frozen_architecture.mtf_confirmation: Daily 45% + Weekly 35% + Monthly 20%; confirmation only and cannot reverse canonical direction.
frozen_architecture.regime_guardrail: LOW_VOL may reach 100; MODERATE_VOL caps 70; HIGH/UNKNOWN_VOL caps 55; STRESSED_DRAWDOWN caps 60.
frozen_architecture.counter_thesis: LOW=PASS; MODERATE=CAUTION; HIGH=FAIL under COUNTER_THESIS_0.2 semantics.
frozen_architecture.six_check_readiness: Canonical Direction, MTF, Regime, Decision Risk, Counter-Thesis, Actionability. One point per PASS; checklist is dependent governance evidence, not six independent statistical signals.

prefreeze_evidence.interpretation: Consumed diagnostic evidence only; these values are not profit probabilities and are not Fresh OOS proof.

prospective_start_rule: Only completed UTC crypto sessions strictly after 2026-08-18 may create Fresh OOS records. Historical backfill is prohibited.

outcome_definition.eligible_prediction: Canonical direction must be SUPPORTIVE or PRESSURED and Actionability Primary Gate must PASS at the frozen completed session.
outcome_definition.primary_endpoint: 7D directional continuation: SUPPORTIVE expects the completed close 7 UTC sessions later to be higher; PRESSURED expects it to be lower.
outcome_definition.mixed_state: Not scored as a directional prediction.
outcome_definition.readiness_6_of_6: Recorded as a quality tier, not required to redefine or override the Actionability Primary Gate.

sample_policy.note: Sample targets are sufficiency gates, not proof; cross-asset and overlapping-horizon dependence must be disclosed.

governance_condition: Six-check readiness is a dependent checklist. Shared underlying inputs across Regime, Risk, Counter-Thesis and Actionability must never be converted into a confidence or probability claim.
